name: my-codex-box
description: Turn local text-based books into structured notes with source-verified quotations.

interface.shortDescription: Create structured book notes with verified quotations
interface.longDescription: Extract a local text PDF, EPUB, TXT, or Markdown book, analyze it chapter by chapter, and reject generated quotations that cannot be found in the source.
defaultPrompt: Turn this local book into structured notes with source-verified quotations.
